missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Лошадь' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Белая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'у реки' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Лошадь' is feminine of the soft type, so its accusative singular matches the nominative as the object of 'кормит'. 'Свою' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Лошади' is in the genitive case after 'нет', the standard negation of existence. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Лошади' is in the dative case as the indirect object receiving the water. 'Свежую воду' is the accusative direct object of 'дал'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Лошадью' is in the instrumental case required by 'любуется'. 'Красивой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, describing the beautiful horse.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О лошади' uses the prepositional form 'лошади' after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Лошадь' is nominative as the subject. 'Быстрая' is the agreeing feminine predicate adjective, and 'очень' intensifies it.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Лошади' is the nominative plural of 'лошадь', acting as the subject of 'пасутся'. 'Серые' agrees in the plural, and 'на поле' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Лошадей' is the animate accusative plural, matching the genitive plural, as the object of 'продал'. 'Двух' agrees in the same case.

missions.phrase: Они приехали в город на лошадях.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'На лошадях' uses the prepositional plural 'лошадях' after 'на' to express the means of travel. 'В город' gives the accusative destination.
